verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.lumalabs.ai, and a second llms.txt at lumalabs.ai/llms.txt summarizes the API, models and pricing. The docs also state that appending .md to any documentation page URL returns a markdown version, which gives agents clean, fetchable docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other consolidated full-content agent bundle, and no independent user report of agents actually consuming these docs.
